end_to_end.note: the promotion metric; GitHub reports both endpoints at one-second resolution

assignment_to_provider_start.note: GARM admission and external provider dispatch

provider_create.note: monotonic duration of the external provider call

guest_assignment_setup.note: assignment script start to runner exec, inside the warm VM

runner_exec_to_broker_session.note: official runner connect: three concurrent Location.GetConnectionData calls, VssConnection and RSA credential load, then one OAuth token request; no retry or backoff is present in any sample

hosted_reference.note: same workflow on GitHub-hosted runners, which are already registered and connected before a job arrives

floor.derivation: end_to_end median minus every segment this repository can change; independent of the runner-connect measurement

verdict.reason: an unregistered warm VM performs the official runner registration and broker connect on the critical path; a GitHub-hosted runner has already completed both before its job is created
